description: Global Hubs publishes a ranked operator table for ocean container shipping lines. Dmitry Golubnichiy provides CSV and Parquet versions with each carrier, headquarters, operated fleet capacity in thousand TEU, market share and revenue where disclosed. The README says its ranking is based on an Alphaliner public Top 100 snapshot dated 1 July 2026. This is an operator-scale list, not ship positions, sailing schedules or route geometry. GitHub and Zenodo state CC0, and the concept DOI points to a public versioned release available without cost. A maritime modeller could use operated capacity to size carrier participation in freight-demand or port-service scenarios. Fleet capacity is not measured cargo throughput; revenue periods vary and private carriers may have no disclosed revenue. This review did not download rows, check the Alphaliner source or verify every consolidated brand. Related Global Hubs datasets describe seaport nodes and freight operators in other modes.
